_comment: Scanner waivers. Every entry names a rule and a path (or path prefix) and MUST carry a reason; a waiver without a reason is ignored. Prefer fixing the artifact over adding an entry.

exceptions.reason: jose compares a PEM header string literal while parsing keys it is given; the match is the header text, not key material (reviewed 2026-11-16).
templates ship a .gitignore that becomes the developer's own file in generated projects (class C, developer-owned).

public LLM development guidance: the documentation portal generates assistant instruction files for DEVELOPERS to place in their own projects (generated from the public docs); it is not conversation history or internal context (reviewed 2026-11-16).
